node: Behind-the-meter power generation, gas turbines, generators, and turbine services
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one reference leader and three discovery-lane companies with direct or second-order exposure to data-center-driven behind-the-meter gas generation. GE Vernova anchors the turbine-slot scarcity thesis. INNIO is newly US-listed and unusually pure in distributed gas engines for data centers. Power Solutions International is a smaller, underfollowed emissions-certified engine/power-systems supplier with stated data-center demand. CECO Environmental is a second-order emissions/noise-control supplier tied to natural-gas power generation supporting data-center expansion. No trading recommendation is implied.
